propositions: Repository achieves 7.5/10 code quality with 87 source modules exceeding 500 LOC target and 206 functions exceeding complexity 15, concentrated in orchestration hotspots like compute() and import_tickets().
Typing coverage passes mypy globally but diagnostic --disallow-untyped-defs run found 687 errors; only rebar.graph and rebar.grounding enforce untyped-defs package-wide.
Architectural enforcement is selective with high-risk seams having bespoke checks but no repository-wide package dependency DAG contract, creating review-dependent cross-layer import risk.
Assignee documentation contradicts reconciler implementation: README and user-guide show bare handle usage while config docs require email/accountId resolution.

CI gate exhibits flakiness: test_opcert_service_app::test_matching_guard_is_accepted causes xdist worker crashes after ~11.4k tests in multiple runs, producing spurious failures and 8–24 minute rerun latency.
